description: This file exports type definitions, functions, and constants related to thread bindings in a Discord extension, acting as an index or barrel file that re-exports symbols from multiple module files.

methods.name: formatThreadBindingDurationLabel
methods.description: Formats a label representing the duration of a thread binding.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingIntroText
methods.description: Resolves introductory text for thread binding display.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingThreadName
methods.description: Resolves the display name of a thread binding.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingPersona
methods.description: Resolves persona information for thread bindings.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingPersonaFromRecord
methods.description: Resolves persona info from a thread binding record.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadBindingIdleTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the idle timeout in milliseconds for a Discord thread binding.

methods.name: resolveDiscordThreadBindingMaxAgeMs
methods.description: Resolves the maximum age in milliseconds for a Discord thread binding.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if thread bindings are enabled.

methods.name: isRecentlyUnboundThreadWebhookMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message is a recent unbound thread webhook message.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingIdleTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the idle timeout in milliseconds for a thread binding.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingInactivityExpiresAt
methods.description: Resolves the expiration timestamp based on inactivity.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingMaxAgeExpiresAt
methods.description: Resolves the expiration timestamp based on maximum age.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingMaxAgeMs
methods.description: Resolves the maximum age in milliseconds for a thread binding.

methods.name: autoBindSpawnedDiscordSubagent
methods.description: Automatically binds a spawned Discord subagent to a thread.

methods.name: listThreadBindingsBySessionKey
methods.description: Lists thread bindings associated with a specific session key.

methods.name: listThreadBindingsForAccount
methods.description: Lists thread bindings associated with a specific account.

methods.name: reconcileAcpThreadBindingsOnStartup
methods.description: Reconciles thread bindings on startup, possibly to fix inconsistencies.

methods.name: setThreadBindingIdleTimeoutBySessionKey
methods.description: Sets the idle timeout for thread bindings by session key.

methods.name: setThreadBindingMaxAgeBySessionKey
methods.description: Sets the maximum age for thread bindings by session key.

methods.name: unbindThreadBindingsBySessionKey
methods.description: Unbinds thread bindings associated with a specific session key.

methods.name: createNoopThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Creates a no-operation thread binding manager.

methods.name: createThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Creates a thread binding manager.

methods.name: getThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Gets the current thread binding manager.
